visits.clientRepPresent: Sunil Mehta (QA Director) & Anand Joshi (Shift QA Lead)
visits.consultantSummaryNotes: Facility demonstrates high GMP discipline in dry blending zones. Two major non-conformances flagged regarding metal detector challenge frequency and wall coving seals.

checklistResponses.section: 1. Senior Management Commitment & Food Safety Culture
checklistResponses.question: Has management established clear food safety objectives, monthly review cadence, and an active confidential reporting channel for food safety concerns?
checklistResponses.observation: Monthly food safety committee minutes reviewed for Q4 2025 and Jan-Feb 2026. Whistleblower policy posted at staff entrance.

checklistResponses.section: 2. Hazard Analysis & Critical Control Points (HACCP / OPRP)
checklistResponses.question: Are Critical Limits validated for CCP-1 (Rare Earth Magnet & Metal Detection on Powder Conveyor 3)?
checklistResponses.observation: Reject mechanism tested only with 2.0mm Ferrous; test protocol lacks documented verification with 2.5mm Non-Ferrous and 3.0mm Stainless Steel test pieces during shift handover.

checklistResponses.question: Are all walls, floor drains, and pipe penetrations sealed to prevent moisture ingress and pest harborage?
checklistResponses.observation: Floor-to-wall epoxy coving in raw spice warehouse bay 2 shows 15cm hairline crack with minor moisture pooling.

enrollments.assessmentRemarks: Excellent understanding of FSSC Version 6 additional requirements and PRPs.

capas.findingTitle: CCP-1 Metal Detector Multi-Specimen Challenge Frequency
capas.findingDescription: Metal detector challenge on powder conveyor 3 lacked testing with 2.5mm Non-Ferrous and 3.0mm Stainless Steel test pieces at shift changes.
capas.rootCauseAnalysis: Operator training syllabus previously covered only ferrous challenge pieces. Shift log sheet did not have dedicated columns for 3-metal specimen verification.
capas.immediateCorrection: Updated hourly CCP log sheet to mandate recording Fe 2.0mm, Non-Fe 2.5mm, and SS 3.0mm challenge results.
capas.preventiveActionPlan: Procured certified test rods and trained 14 operators on line 3. Instituted QA supervisor verification twice per shift.

evidenceList.notes: Attached scanned signed log sheet showing 3-piece test implementation over 7 consecutive days with zero failures.
